Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive view. Let me create a final summary report based on all my findings.

## Clients Page Audit Map

**1. CLIENTS PAGE ROUTE & SUB-TABS**

- **Main Route**: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS/app/(app)/clients/page.tsx`
  - Server-rendered page with 4 tabs (CLIENTS_TABS array lines 26–50)
  - Prefetches initial clients & tags data when tab="all" is active

**Tabs & Components:**
- **"All Clients"** (tab=all) → `ClientsPageClient` component — renders client list with filters, table, views
- **"Tags"** (tab=tags) → `TagsManager` from `/components/settings/tags/TagsManager.tsx` — drag-reorder, edit, delete tags with usage counts
- **"Consent Forms"** (tab=consent-forms) → `SubmissionsTable` + `TemplatesGrid` from `/components/consent/` — dual sub-tabs (Submissions / Templates)
- **"AI Design"** (tab=ai-design) → `AiDesignHub` from `/components/ai/AiDesignHub.tsx` — gated by `pro` plan; shows gallery/new design request form

**2. "+ NEW CLIENT" CTA**

- **Location**: Button in `ClientsPageClient.tsx` line 294–297 — styled `<Plus>` icon + "New client" label
- **Behavior**: `handleNewClient()` (line 230–232) → opens `ClientDrawer` in create mode (sets `editingClient = null`)
- **Form Component**: `ClientDrawer` at `/components/clients/ClientDrawer.tsx`
- **Submission**: 
  - **POST endpoint**: `/api/clients` (create) or `/api/clients/{id}` (update)
  - Route file: `/app/api/clients/route.ts` — line 248 handles POST
  - **API Route PATCH**: `/app/api/clients/[id]/route.ts` handles updates
  - Uses fetch (lines 244–250 in ClientDrawer)
- **Form Fields**: 6 sections — Basics (name, email, phone, DOB), Address, Social (IG/TikTok/website), Tags & Source, Notes, Consent for minors

**3. MAIN CLIENT LIST TABLE**

- **Component**: `ClientsTable` at `/components/clients/ClientsTable.tsx`
- **Renders**: Row per client with name, contact icons, tags, health badge, LTV, last visit, actions menu (edit/note/archive)
- **Selection**: Checkbox multi-select (feeds into `BulkActionsBar`)
- **Pagination**: Infinite scroll via "Load more" (line 218–222 in ClientsPageClient)

**4. SAVED-VIEW CHIPS (Switcher)**

- **Component**: `SavedViewSwitcher` at `/components/clients/SavedViewSwitcher.tsx`
- **System Views**: Fetched from `/api/client-views` (line 80 in ClientsPageClient)
- **Chips**: Shows active view name + dropdown menu with create/edit/duplicate/delete options
- **Create/Edit Modal**: `SavedViewManager` at `/components/clients/SavedViewManager.tsx`
- **API**: POST/PATCH `/api/client-views`, DELETE `/api/client-views/{viewId}`

**5. FILTER TOOLBAR**

- **Component**: `ClientFilterBar` at `/components/clients/ClientFilterBar.tsx`
- **Filters** (in interface lines 25–37):
  - Search query (`q`)
  - Tags (multi-select popover)
  - VIP toggle
  - Inactive clients (90d+)
  - No-shows toggle
  - Has alerts toggle
  - Spending tier / LTV (popover: $0–$500, $500–$2K, $2K–$5K, $5K+)
  - Last visit range (popover: 30d, 90d, 90d+, never)
  - Artists filter (if populated)
  - Services filter (if populated)
- **Active filter chips**: Display below toolbar as removable badges (lines 472–490)
- **Clear all**: Button to reset all filters

**6. COLUMNS PICKER + ARCHIVED TOGGLE**

- **Columns Picker**: Placeholder button line 444–453 — labeled "Columns" with `Columns3` icon
  - ID: `column-toggle-trigger` (wired but not yet functional — comment says "wired in ClientsPageClient")
- **Archived Toggle**: Button line 456–468 — Eye/EyeOff icon; text "Archived" / "Hide archived"
  - Toggles `filters.showArchived` boolean

**7. EMPTY STATES** (lines 378–410)

Three variants:
- **No match filters**: `<EmptyState>` "No clients match these filters" → "Clear filters" CTA (SearchX icon)
- **Empty saved view**: "No clients in this view" → "Edit view filters" CTA (BookmarkX icon)
- **First-time (no clients)**: "No clients yet" → "+ Add client" CTA (Users icon)

---

**RELATED SURFACES FOR AUDIT MOVES**

- **Tags Management Settings**: Currently embedded in Clients page tab. `TagsManager` lives at `/components/settings/tags/TagsManager.tsx`. **No dedicated route exists yet** — `/app/(app)/settings/tags/` is an empty directory (no page.tsx).
- **AI Design Feature**: Standalone `AiDesignHub` at `/components/ai/AiDesignHub.tsx` — can be moved to dedicated route (e.g., `/ai-design` or `/designers`) without refactoring other Clients page pieces.
